data.title: 阿尔法 · 池畔金辉下的薄凉浅酌
data.description: 盛夏午后无人的私人泳池畔，阿尔法侧倚在白色遮阳躺椅边，修长双腿没入清澈碧水中。她托着盛有冰镇特调的玻璃杯，金发在微风中轻拂，向身侧之人递来宁静从容的注视。
data.location: luxurious private infinity pool terrace overlooking an ocean horizon under sunny sky
data.action: sitting on the edge of a white poolside lounger, one hand holding an iced cocktail glass with a lime slice, water ripples lapping at feet, gentle slight smile
data.lighting: sparkling tropical sunlight reflecting off crystal pool water with soft warm shadows
data.mood: serene summer luxury, effortless aristocratic elegance, quiet private bond
data.promptProse: Alpha sits by a crystal blue private pool terrace holding a cold summer drink, golden hair catching warm sunlight as water sparkles around her.
data.animaCaption: Alpha relaxing poolside with an iced cocktail under radiant summer light.
